name: Validity Period Type 1 Code
definition: Code defining the conditions under which an order becomes active or is removed from an orderbook.

FOKV.name: Fill Or Kill
FOKV.definition: Orde executed upon its entering into the order book provided that it can be fully filled (e.g. in the event the order can only be partially executed, then it is automatically rejected and cannot therefore be executed).

GADV.name: Good After Date
GADV.definition: Order being active only from the beginning of a pre-determined date.

GASV.name: Good After Specified Date Time
GASV.definition: Order being active only from a pre-determined time on a pre-determined date.

GATV.name: Good After Time
GATV.definition: Order being active only after a pre-determined time within the current trading session.

DAVY.name: Good For Day
DAVY.definition: Order expiring at the end of the trading day on which it was entered in the order book.

GTCV.name: Good Till Cancelled
GTCV.definition: Order remaining active in the order book and be executable until it is actually cancelled

GTDV.name: Good Till Date
GTDV.definition: Order expiring at the end of a specified date.

GTSV.name: Good Till Specified Date Time
GTSV.definition: Order expiring at a specified date and time.

GTTV.name: Good Till Time
GTTV.definition: Order expiring at the latest at a pre-determined time within the current trading session.

IOCV.name: Immediate Or Cancel
IOCV.definition: Order executed upon its entering into the order book (for the quantity that can be executed) and which does not remain in the order book for the remaining quantity (if any) that has not been executed.
